human_intent_contract: Introduce HumanIntentDecision as an invocation-bound typed input distinct from EffectDecision and WorldEffectVerification.
HumanIntentDecision binds invocation_id/call_id + normalized or canonical request digest + source modality/utterance provenance + freshness window + policy class.

Explicit confirmation is mandatory where policy marks the mutation class as confirmation-required; low-risk reversible internal mutations may use an explicitly defined implicit-intent policy, never accidental fall-through from a different tool branch.
effect_contract: External effects remain behind deterministic EntityOS EffectGate/EffectJournal even after HumanIntentDecision succeeds.
HumanIntentDecision is evidence of user intent, not execution authority; EffectDecision remains separately one-shot, request-digest/generation/capability bound and executor-consumed.
Cancellation-before-submission invalidates pending decisions; after submission, uncertain outcome remains OUTCOME_UNKNOWN until verified.
